dog.description_text:
💕 STORMY
🐶 Female | 9–10 weeks old (currently) | 11.5 lbs.
🐾 Possible German Shepherd/Black Mouth Cur mix

If you're looking for a puppy who will greet you with her ENTIRE BODY, meet Stormy. 😂❤️

Stormy was found all alone by a student at a local school. Sadly, we suspect this sweet little girl may have been dumped. Thankfully, she was found—and now she's getting her chance at the life she deserves.

And Stormy is making the MOST of it!
dog.name: Stormy
